title: Impact of Grade Retention on Future Academic Performance
research_question: Does retaining students who score just below a cutoff on end-of-year tests affect their future academic performance negatively? This study aims to determine the causal impact of grade retention on subsequent test scores.
data_description: The dataset includes 400 students with columns for running_var (end-of-year test scores), treated (indicator for retention), and y (future test scores). The data focuses on students near the cutoff score for grade retention.
